name: primary_condition_v3
status: proposed development reference (DEC-043 proposed); not frozen
condition: learned reader (tied cosine + pairwise null + lexical overlap, stop list v1), stable observations, per-position delta writes (5 normalized adjoint steps, τ 0.1, A 0.3, v2 b_m), hard top-1 selection, null threshold 0.5, no cosine gate, binary write mass, top-k 4; R1-56 rare-token overlap gate: the query must share ≥ 1 non-stop token with the selected record's support prompt that occurs in ≤ 2 active records (rare_overlap_min=1, rare_df_max=2)
training: stream-scale mixed-domain episodes (64-record memories; CounterFact pool v1 + zsRE pool v1, 1,000 items each; 300 steps × 2; lr 1e-3; wd 0.01) plus 8 ordinary-text null queries per episode (512 OpenWebText training-range windows × prefix lengths 16/48/96, cap-off logits kept for the preservation KL; --text-nulls 8 --text-windows 512), scripts/r1_50_stream_train.py
